data.one_liner: Customizable SVG avatar library with a UI customizer and circle avatar widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets like FluttermojiCircleAvatar, FluttermojiCustomizer, and FluttermojiSaveWidget to let users generate, customize, and render avatar graphics in Flutter applications. It also includes helper functions to encode, decode, and store avatar attributes.
use_when: You want to allow users to create and customize their own cartoon-style SVG avatars within your app.
You need a lightweight avatar display widget that integrates with local storage and syncs across the widget tree in real time.
avoid_when: You need complex 3D avatars or realistic user profile photos rather than 2D SVG graphic illustrations.
You are building for web without using the canvaskit renderer, as the default html renderer will not work with SVGs.
strengths: Includes a comprehensive built-in UI for customizing avatars.
Provides utility functions for encoding and decoding avatar data to send to a backend.
Real-time communication between customizer and avatar widgets.
weaknesses: Renders a default avatar until customized and saved for the first time by the local user.
Displaying avatars of other users requires manual usage of SvgPicture.string() rather than built-in multi-user widgets.
Web support is limited to the canvaskit renderer.
data.setup_notes: Add fluttermoji to pubspec.yaml, import the library, and place FluttermojiCircleAvatar and FluttermojiCustomizer widgets in your UI.
